patch.description: A change to `marketingOptIn` also writes a `consent_records` row, because the DPDP notice-and-choice record has to say when and from where the choice was made (D61).
patch.summary: Update name, avatar, locale, onboarding state or marketing opt-in

delete.description: Records a `dsr_requests` row of kind `erasure`, marks the account deleted, anonymises the address and revokes every session immediately. The cascade over media, transcripts and derived objects is B16 and has 30 days to run.

get.description: Records a `dsr_requests` row of kind `export` (DPDP Rule 14: answered within 30 days) and returns a single-use download link that expires in an hour. B16 adds media, transcripts and exports to the bundle.

200.description: The rights request and its download link.

get.summary: Export everything the account holds about you

post.description: Always answers the same way, whether or not the address is already registered: a registration form that says 'already taken' is a free account checker. Blocked by the age gate (403 auth/age_restricted) for India under 18 and the EU under 16.

post.summary: Confirm an email address with a single-use token

post.description: One message for an unknown address and a wrong password alike, and the same argon2 cost is paid either way.
post.summary: Sign in with email and password

200.description: Accepted, whether or not the address has an account.

post.summary: Email a single-use sign-in link (15 minutes)
Exchange a magic-link token for tokens

post.description: Rotation with a 60-second grace: presenting the previous token inside the window replays the same new pair, presenting it after the window revokes the whole family.

Takes the refresh token rather than the access token, so a client whose access token has already expired can still sign out. Always 204: an unknown token must not be a way to test whether a token is live.
The workspace is bound into the access token; there is no X-Workspace-Id header (07 section Conventions, THREAT-MODEL T4). Membership is re-checked here.

delete.summary: Revoke one session (and its refresh-token family)

post.description: Offered to a sign-up blocked by the age gate (D60), until a verifiable parental-consent flow ships.

get.description: Stores the PKCE verifier and the originating client for 10 minutes, then redirects to Google. `client` decides where the callback sends the browser back to.
Exchanges the authorization code, links or creates the identity, and redirects on with a single-use handoff code. Tokens are never put in a redirect URL.

post.description: When the callback reported `status=registration` this call must also carry `dateOfBirth` and `jurisdiction`: Google does not supply a date of birth and D60 requires one before an account exists.
post.summary: Exchange the handoff code for tokens

post.description: Returns an 8-character user code from an alphabet with no ambiguous glyphs, a 10-minute expiry and a 5-second polling interval. At most five flows may be in flight from one address.

201.description: A device code and a user code.

post.description: 400 with `auth/authorization_pending` until the code is approved, `auth/slow_down` when polled faster than the interval, `auth/expired_token` after 10 minutes and `auth/access_denied` when the user declines.

get.description: The approval screen's data: host application, device facts, address and a coarse location, so a user can tell a device on their desk from one on somebody else's.

post.description: `workspaceId` defaults to the workspace of the approving session and is always re-checked against memberships.
post.summary: Approve or decline a device sign-in

get.description: Not scoped to the token's `ws` claim: this is the list a workspace switcher renders, and switching goes through `POST /auth/token/exchange`.
get.summary: The workspaces the caller belongs to

post.description: The caller becomes its owner. Region and currency follow their declared jurisdiction and the billing country starts **unconfirmed** — a guess until somebody sets a tax profile on it.
post.summary: Create a team or agency workspace

patch.description: `settings` is merged, not replaced, so a partial patch keeps the rest.
patch.summary: Rename a workspace or change its settings

delete.description: Soft delete; every session scoped to it is revoked. Refused when it is the caller's only workspace — `DELETE /me` is how a person leaves altogether.

put.description: India requires a validated GST State code (D41, Circular 242/36/2024-GST); a GSTIN is optional but is checked against its base-36 check digit and must name the same State. Currency follows the country (IN → INR, otherwise USD) and is locked once a subscription exists. Confirming a profile stamps `billingCountryConfirmedAt`, which is what B01 requires before a checkout.

200.description: The workspace with its tax profile.

put.summary: Set the billing country, State and GSTIN

get.description: Cached 60 seconds (07 §Workspaces). **Stub:** the Free plan's entitlements for every workspace; B02 computes plan + seats + passes + flags.

get.summary: The workspace's members and outstanding invitations

post.description: Creates a pending `memberships` row and sends the invitation. The row becomes a membership only when that person accepts it themselves, from a verified address.
post.summary: Invite an address to the workspace

patch.description: The owner's role is immutable, and nobody may grant a role above their own.

delete.description: Every session that member holds in this workspace is revoked at once.
delete.summary: Remove a member or withdraw an invitation

get.description: Empty until the address is verified: an invitation is an authorisation grant.
get.summary: Invitations waiting for the caller's address

post.description: Joins the workspace. The caller's session is untouched — exchange a token for the returned `workspaceId` to start working in it.

get.description: `reconsentRequired` is true when a purpose was last answered against an older privacy notice — the choice has to be asked again (D61, Rule 3).
get.summary: The caller's current answer for every purpose

post.description: Appends a `consent_records` row with the caller's address, user agent and the current notice version. A refusal is recorded as a row, not as an absent row: the record has to show what was asked as well as what was agreed.

get.description: Version metadata and the purpose list a consent form renders (DPDP Rule 3). `version` is the string stamped onto every `consent_records` row; the prose moves to the content module when it ships.

Addresses are stored only as a SHA-256 digest, so this answers how many people are waiting and since when, not who they are. Authorised from the `privacy.platformAdmins` entry of FEATURE_FLAGS_JSON until B13 ships the admin application; nobody is an administrator by default.

200.description: One page of the waiting list, oldest first.

get.description: Cursor pagination: pass the previous page's `nextCursor` as `cursor`. Ids are ULIDs, so the cursor is stable and ordered by creation time.
get.summary: List the workspace's jobs, newest first

get.description: Rows are purged 30 days after they are written (`data.retainUntil`).
get.summary: The job's event log, oldest first

post.description: Releases the credit hold. A finished job is `jobs/invalid_state` (409).
post.summary: Cancel a queued or running job

info.title: Aksharo API
info.description: Errors use the envelope `{ error: { code, message, details?, requestId } }` with `namespace/slug` codes (CONTRACTS section 8).

priority.description: Lower runs first; derived from the workspace's plan.

jobKey.description: Deduplication key: one live job per (workspace, key).

attemptId.description: Identifies this run of the job.

creditsChargedTenths.description: Credits in tenths: the hold while running, the charge once finished.

maxQueueWaitMs.description: Milliseconds this job may wait in `queued`.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page.

error.description: Present only when the check failed.
